concepts.angle: Rest is a skill people are actively bad at.
concepts.coverImageIntent: man sitting alone plain background daylight

slides.text: tiredness is physical. what most people feel is an open loop.
write down the thing you keep half-remembering. the tiredness lifts.
slides.imageIntent: young man reading plain background daylight

slides.text: rest does not work while the loop is still running.
close it badly rather than leave it open.

concepts.closerImageIntent: person standing still white background studio
concepts.longHook: you are not tired, you are unfinished

slides.text: you will not out-willpower a phone on the pillow next to you.
make the good thing take ten seconds and the bad thing take ten minutes.
slides.imageIntent: woman looking down plain background daylight

slides.text: every habit you kept was one you made easy by accident.
design the room once instead of deciding a hundred times.
slides.imageIntent: man sitting alone plain background daylight

concepts.closerImageIntent: person standing still white background studio
concepts.longHook: stop relying on discipline, change the room
